scripts.postinstallDev: yarn prepare && yarn lerna:prepare && yarn ruby:install
scripts.lerna:prepare: cross-env NX_NO_CLOUD=true NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY=.nx/cache NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY=.nx/workspace-data lerna run prepare
scripts.lint: yarn lint:js && yarn lint:deps && yarn lint:android && yarn lint:ios:check
scripts.lint:android:
(find packages/*/android/src -name '*.java' -not -path '*/generated/*' ! -name 'ReactNativeFirebaseVersion.java' -print0 | xargs -0 google-java-format --set-exit-if-changed --replace || (echo "

android formatting error - please re-run

" && exit 1)) && (git diff --exit-code packages/*/android/src || (echo "

android files changed from linting, please examine and commit result

" && exit 1))
scripts.lint:all: yarn lint && yarn lint:markdown && yarn lint:spellcheck && yarn tsc:compile
scripts.tests:android:build:default: bash -c 'source ./scripts/e2e/lib/e2e-slot-env.sh && e2e_sanitize_serial_env && export ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_reactNativeDevServerPort="${RNFB_ANDROID_METRO_PORT:-${RCT_METRO_PORT:-${RNFB_METRO_PORT:-${JET_METRO_PORT:-8081}}}}" && cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration "${RNFB_DETOX_ANDROID_CONFIG:-android.emu.debug}"'
scripts.tests:android:build:windows: cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration android.emu.debug.windows
scripts.tests:android:build:release: cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration android.emu.release
scripts.tests:android:test: bash -c 'source ./scripts/e2e/lib/e2e-slot-env.sh && e2e_sanitize_serial_env && e2e_assert_android_apk_metro_port && cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration "${RNFB_DETOX_ANDROID_CONFIG:-android.emu.debug}"'
scripts.tests:android:test:debug: cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --inspect
scripts.tests:android:test-reuse: cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --reuse
scripts.tests:android:test-cover: bash -c 'source ./scripts/e2e/lib/e2e-slot-env.sh && e2e_sanitize_serial_env && e2e_assert_android_apk_metro_port && cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration "${RNFB_DETOX_ANDROID_CONFIG:-android.emu.debug}" --loglevel verbose'
scripts.tests:android:test-cover-reuse: cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --reuse
scripts.tests:ios:build: bash -c 'source ./scripts/e2e/lib/e2e-slot-env.sh && e2e_sanitize_serial_env && cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration "${RNFB_DETOX_IOS_CONFIG:-ios.sim.debug}"'
scripts.tests:ios:build:release: cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration ios.sim.release
scripts.tests:ios:manual: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 CC=clang CPLUSPLUS=clang++ LD=clang LDPLUSPLUS=clang++ yarn react-native run-ios
scripts.tests:ios:test: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --loglevel warn
scripts.tests:ios:test:release: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.release --loglevel warn
scripts.tests:ios:test:debug: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --loglevel warn --inspect
scripts.tests:ios:test-reuse: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --reuse --loglevel warn
scripts.tests:ios:test-cover: bash -c 'source ./scripts/e2e/lib/e2e-slot-env.sh && e2e_sanitize_serial_env && cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration "${RNFB_DETOX_IOS_CONFIG:-ios.sim.debug}" --loglevel verbose'
scripts.tests:ios:test-cover-reuse: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --reuse --loglevel warn
scripts.tests:ios:pod:install: cd tests/ios && bundle exec pod install
scripts.lint:ruby: bundle exec rubocop --config packages/app/__tests__/.rubocop.yml packages/app/firebase_spm.rb packages/app/firebase_json.rb packages/app/__tests__
scripts.tests:macos:build: bash -c 'source ./scripts/e2e/lib/e2e-slot-env.sh && e2e_sanitize_serial_env && cd tests-macos && yarn build:macos'
scripts.tests:macos:pod:install: cd tests-macos/macos && bundle exec pod install
scripts.tests:macos:test: bash -c 'source ./scripts/e2e/lib/e2e-slot-env.sh && e2e_sanitize_serial_env && cd tests-macos && npx jet --target=macos --coverage'
scripts.tests:macos:test-cover: bash -c 'source ./scripts/e2e/lib/e2e-slot-env.sh && e2e_sanitize_serial_env && cd tests-macos && npx jet --target=macos --coverage'
